input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Johnson City, Erwin, Jonesborough, Elizabethton, Greeneville and Newport, Tennessee. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Doe River Gorge Ministries
candidates.note: Residential adventure camps for children and teens, plus teen leadership programs.

candidates.name: Appalachian Christian Camp (Camp ACC)
candidates.note: Elementary through high-school summer camps with Bible study, swimming, climbing and outdoor activities; ran in 2026.

candidates.name: Children's Bible Ministries of East Tennessee
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ta-Pa-Win-Go: 2026 overnight camps for ages 8–17 and day options for ages 5–17.

candidates.name: Camp Greene
candidates.note: Christian summer camp with overnight lodging; official registration page advertised summer 2026.

candidates.name: University of Tennessee Extension — Clyde Austin 4-H Center
candidates.note: Junior residential camps for grades 4–6 and junior-high summer camp; 2026 and 2027 information posted.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: GattonRx residential pharmacy camp for high-school students ran June 1–5, 2026; also runs daytime summer camps.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: 2026 Nike Tennis Camp at Tusculum University offered overnight and full-day options for ages 9–18.

candidates.name: Tusculum University
candidates.note: Women's soccer summer overnight ID camp listed for July 19–22, 2026.

candidates.name: Universal Cheerleaders Association
candidates.note: Residential cheer camps at ETSU with squads staying in campus dormitories.

candidates.name: Crossings Camps
candidates.note: Kids and student camps at Carson Springs; 2027 residential student session announced for July 12–16.

candidates.name: Lifeway — FUGE Camps
candidates.note: 2026 residential youth camps at Carson Springs and Milligan University, including Centrifuge and campus-based programs.

candidates.name: Tennessee Baptist Mission Board
candidates.note: All Nations Camp at Carson Springs ran June 8–12, 2026, for ages 6–17 from ethnic congregations.

candidates.name: Appalachian Free Will Baptist Association
candidates.note: Youth camp at The Oaks for rising grades 4–12; 2027 permission form lists June 7–10.

candidates.name: Sequoyah Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Davy Crockett offers weeklong Scout summer camps on Cherokee Lake; 2026 sessions confirmed.
